# dwpk

> Development Workspace Platform for Kubernetes

dwpk (Development Workspace Platform for Kubernetes) is a self-service platform for persistent developer environments on your own Kubernetes cluster: a catalog of container images, one namespace and quota per person, and access over SSH, VS Code Remote-SSH, or a browser terminal. No external database - state lives in Kubernetes CRDs.


## Getting started

- [Home](https://devops-ia.github.io/dwpk/1.0/index.md): What dwpk is, why it exists, and how the three components fit together
